Forest of Veymor: In the forest of Veymor, trees bent to whisper forgotten names. Moss glowed beneath footfalls. Illusions hunted truth.
There, Lysander met Thim, a child made of bark. The wind had stolen Thim's name, and with it, their form. To restore it, Lysander ventured deep into the Grove of Lost Things.
Among carnivorous daisies and whispering shadows, Lysander retrieved Thim's name by decoding leafglyphs carved onto a memory stone.
Upon return, Thim smiled for the first time in years and gifted them the Compass of Longing, pointing not to places—but to what the soul needed most.
'Trust it,' Thim whispered. 'But only if you dare to know yourself.'
